up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5725229. For each compound, return the following: compound ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), compound name (preferred name, pref_name), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). Include one row per unique compound. If any of these fields are missing for a compound, show null. Do not restrict by document type, confidence score, target type, or any other criteria not explicitly requested.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725229';
